# HELIOS-X: AI-Powered Astronomical Exploration & Scientific Investigation

The universe is full of unanswered questions. Understanding it requires curiosity, critical thinking, pattern recognition, and evidence-based reasoning.

HELIOS-X combines real NASA SPHEREx observations, interactive visualization, and multi-agent AI to make astronomical exploration more accessible to researchers, students, and citizen scientists.

Users can explore sky images, navigate observation epochs with the Sky Time Machine, and compare observations to examine possible patterns and changes. Guided Mode supports beginners, while Researcher Mode provides deeper scientific information.

Its eight specialized AI agents retrieve and validate data, detect potential changes, analyze motion and spectral properties, cross-match catalogues, and evaluate scientific hypotheses. Six evidence gates assess the quality and reliability of investigation results.

By connecting exploration with structured investigation, HELIOS-X encourages scientific curiosity, analytical thinking, and inquiry-based learning. It organizes evidence and prioritizes candidates for independent verification; it does not declare unknown objects to be discoveries.

HELIOS-X. Explore. Investigate. Validate.
details:
HELIOS-X: AI-Powered Astronomical Exploration and Scientific Investigation

HELIOS-X is an AI-powered platform that combines real NASA SPHEREx astronomical observations with interactive visualization and multi-agent scientific investigation. It aims to make complex astronomical data more accessible to researchers, students, and citizen scientists.

The platform has two core components. The Image Explorer allows users to discover astronomical observations, inspect sky images, navigate actual observation epochs using the Sky Time Machine, and compare observations across time. Guided Mode helps beginners explore scientific data, while Researcher Mode provides access to deeper technical information.

The Agentic Investigation System uses eight specialized AI agents coordinated by an Investigation Planner. These agents retrieve astronomical data, assess data quality, detect potential changes, analyze celestial motion and spectral-photometric properties, cross-match astronomical catalogues, and evaluate scientific hypotheses. Six evidence gates assess the reliability and scientific relevance of the results.

The platform benefits users by reducing the complexity of astronomical data exploration, supporting evidence-based investigation, and encouraging scientific curiosity, analytical thinking, and inquiry-based learning. For the search for Planet X, HELIOS-X can help prioritize potential candidates for independent verification and follow-up observations. It does not automatically declare unknown objects to be new planets or confirmed discoveries.

The project was developed using Python and FastAPI for the backend, React, TypeScript, and Vite for the frontend, and Supabase PostgreSQL for database management. Scientific tools and libraries include Astropy, NumPy, Astroquery, and PyVO. The AI capabilities use the Google Gemini API, alongside a structured workflow engine for coordinating agent execution. The project uses real astronomical data from the NASA/IPAC SPHEREx archive, with catalogue cross-matching capabilities involving Gaia and AllWISE.

The creative aspect of HELIOS-X is the integration of interactive astronomical exploration with a coordinated multi-agent investigation system. Instead of simply displaying astronomical images or generating AI explanations, it connects observations to structured scientific analysis and evidence evaluation.

During development, the team considered scientific accuracy, data provenance, observation timestamps, reliability of measurements, accessibility for different experience levels, responsible AI use, and the importance of human scientific judgment. The ultimate goal is to connect astronomy, artificial intelligence, and education in an environment where curiosity leads to investigation and evidence leads to scientific understanding.

HELIOS-X. Explore. Investigate. Validate.
